remarks: Welcome to Chérot in St. Albert! This brand-new Landon duplex by Rohit Homes offers 1,617 sq ft with 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms and a double attached garage. Finished in the Global Muse Designer Interior, it blends warm layered textures, brushed brass and handcrafted character for a home that feels collected over time. The main floor features 9' ceilings and a central kitchen with a large island, integrated cabinet hood fan and walk-in pantry, open to the dining area and a living room brightened by a large rear window. A generous foyer and a privately tucked-away half bath complete the level. Upstairs, the primary suite fits a king bed and offers a walk-in closet and ensuite. Two large secondary bedrooms, a full bath, a bright flex room ideal for an office or playroom, a linen closet and upper-floor laundry round out the plan. The unfinished basement is ready for future development. Close to parks, trails and schools, with quick access to Ray Gibbon Drive and Anthony Henday. (id:67522)
